name: hunter
description: Hunter.io: domain search, email finder and verifier (credits), email count, enrichment, company discovery, account, leads and leads lists; agent lead writes need an opt-in, deletes are node only

nodes.title: Domain search
nodes.description: Email addresses Hunter knows for a domain or company, with names, positions, sources and the email pattern (uses search credits)

domain.description: Domain, e.g. stripe.com (takes precedence over company)

company.description: Company name, when the domain is unknown (less accurate)

department.description: e.g. executive, it, finance, management, sales, legal, support, hr, marketing, communication, education, design, health, operations

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
